_comment: Game/system parameters. Somersloop multipliers are the CONFIRMED in-game formula (see _sloops below and Design.md §8). Overclocking uses discrete clock tiers (the overclock key below); machines opt in per spec via machines/*.json 'overclockable'. Augmenter/geothermal and item sink_points may still be placeholder.

overclock._note: Discrete clock values available to overclockable machines, as multiples of 100% clock. Below 1.0 = underclocking (power-efficient: draw scales by c^1.321928, which is sub-linear below 100%); above = overclocking up to the 250% game cap. The MILP gets one column per tier for each slooped grade and for the sole grade of 0-slot machines (miners); the continuous un-slooped grade of slot machines gets only the <=1.0 (underclock) subset. 1.0 is always included; tiers may need tuning once real sink points/recipes land.

augmenters._note: Each Alien Power Augmenter costs `cost` Somersloops; adds `bonus` * base (unaugmented) generation, additively (not compounding); AND generates `power_mw` MW of flat power itself, to which the bonus does NOT apply (confirmed in-game).

power._note: Generation overproduction (reserve) as a fraction of the load (default 0.01 = 1%). The grid must deliver (1 + overproduction) * consumption, so the optimizer never plans to run generation at exactly 100% of what consumers draw; the report keeps this much capacity as headroom. Generators were otherwise throttled to exactly match demand.

resources._note: OPTIONAL extra per-item cap on total recipe consumption. Map extraction is modeled as MINER/MACHINE recipes (see recipes/*); the per-node limit for miners lives in the map_resources table below (ingress), NOT here. Leave this table empty when miners are modeled as recipes so supply is not double-limited.

map_resources._note: Node-group caps for mined map resources: each key is one resource x purity (one in-game node type, e.g. 'iron_node_normal'). Every mining recipe (any miner tier mk1/mk2/mk3) carries map_resource = <same key>, and the TOTAL number of machines across the group is capped at the value here — one miner per node, so tiers share the cap. Counts are the number of nodes of that type.

_sloops._note: CONFIRMED in-game formula, hardcoded in factory_optimiser/io_config.sloop_multipliers: a machine with k of its T total Somersloop slots (T = the machine's max_sloops, see machines/*.json) gets rho = 1 + k/T on output, kappa = 1 on inputs (inputs do NOT increase), and pi = (1 + k/T)^2 on power draw. Full slots -> 2x output; e.g. 1 of 2 slots -> 1.5x output, same input, 2.25x power. Nothing is configured here.
